## What changed

Describe the narrow change and the failure or question it addresses.

## Evidence

List the synthetic fixture, test and commands used to check the claim.

## Limits

State what this change does not prove or support.

## Safety check

- [ ] The patch contains no private documents, private-derived hashes, machine paths, email, extracted private content, model files or runtime output.
- [ ] Native parser output remains separate from normalized units.
- [ ] New or changed units keep typed source provenance.
- [ ] Tests, synthetic proof, comparison proof, compilation and release audit pass.
